title: ClientError missing #[non_exhaustive]: adding variant is semver break
description: ClientError is a public error enum in a library crate with no #[non_exhaustive] attribute. Every downstream caller that matches exhaustively (which is natural for Result error handling) will get a compile break when any variant is added. The client_error_no_rate_limited_variant test proves external callers can already write exhaustive matches. Fix: add #[non_exhaustive] to ClientError, update the internal exhaustive-match test to use a catch-all arm for the sentinel check.
